description: This file defines a serializer class for handling Twilio Media Streams WebSocket protocol within the Pipecat project. It manages converting Pipecat frames to Twilio WebSocket messages and vice versa, including audio encoding/decoding, DTMF event handling, and call termination via Twilio's REST API.

classes.name: TwilioFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for converting Pipecat frames to Twilio WebSocket protocol messages and vice versa, including call management and media handling.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the serializer type, either TEXT or BINARY.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline settings, particularly the input sample rate.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into Twilio WebSocket messages, handling media, interruption, and call hang-up.

methods.name: _hang_up_call
methods.description: Uses Twilio's REST API to terminate the call programmatically.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts incoming Twilio WebSocket messages into Pipecat frames, including media and DTMF events.
